name: KIVI (4-bit)
tagline: KIVI's mixed-axis 4-bit KV quantizer: per-channel groups for keys, per-token groups for values, with FP16 residual sliding windows on both.
diff_from_baseline: Liu et al. 2024 (KIVI, ICML). Plug-and-play 2-bit/4-bit asymmetric KV quantization with per-channel keys + per-token values and a sliding FP16 residual window. Recreated here at 4-bit with KIVI's overlap residual policy.

name: KVTuner-4 (KIVI-style)
tagline: KVTuner's per-layer K/V bit preset (mostly 4-bit keys, 2-bit values) with KIVI-style mixed-axis quantization for Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct.
diff_from_baseline: He et al. 2025 (KVTuner). Per-layer K/V bit-width search over the KIVI mixed-axis quantizer; this baseline applies the official KIVI-style preset for Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct.

name: KVTuner-4 (per-token)
tagline: KVTuner per-layer bit preset for Qwen2.5-3B with simple per-token asymmetric quantization (no axis transpose, no residual).
diff_from_baseline: He et al. 2025 (KVTuner). Official per-token preset variant: same per-layer bit search, but applied to a simpler per-token quantizer without KIVI's axis transpose or residual buffer.

name: SQuat (4-bit)
tagline: Subspace-aware 4-bit key quantizer: prefill query SVD defines an orthogonal subspace; per-group key error is propagated forward in the head-dim using a low-rank inverse so the projection of error onto the query subspace is minimized.
diff_from_baseline: Wang et al. 2025 (SQuat, arXiv:2503.24358). Subspace-orthogonal KV quantization that uses a prefill query SVD to redirect quantization error away from the query subspace; we use it at 4-bit with per-token group-wise dequantization plus value-side min-max 4-bit.
